criteria.requirement: Repair Tree.update_node identifier updates: preflight hashability/None/collisions before mutating anything, preserve object identity and update index/root/parent successors/child predecessors consistently. Same identifier is a no-op for identity while other attributes may update. Reject renaming a node shared across multiple tree contexts rather than corrupt another view. If a property setter or relationship update fails, restore all node attribute containers, index and current-tree pointers; do not claim to reverse arbitrary external side effects or mutate/copy user data internals. Preserve existing ordinary tag/data updates and node subclass behavior. Duplicate IDs may use existing DuplicatedNodeIdError; other invalid identities fail clearly.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
